override.reason: This is a deliberate, documented, epic-wide idiom (established at w2-basis, reused identically by g1/g3/g4/g5's own classes before this gate) so each gate's red-proof class stays self-contained and independently skippable/removable as HEAD moves across the epic's own sequence of commits, rather than sharing brittle cross-class state. Extracting a shared mixin would couple classes whose lifecycles (pinned to different HEADs, removed/archived independently once the epic closes) are intentionally decoupled -- the duplication buys isolation the epic's own sequencing needs.

The long map_check_note documents WHY the check is shaped and placed as it is (schema-sanctioned use, precedented by COMMANDER_SPINE's context/plan steps) -- it does not excuse or paper over a defect in the shell command itself, which is independently simple and correct.
